targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, '1m') AS time, server_name, avg(sql_cpu_utilization) AS SQL_CPU, avg(other_cpu_utilization) AS Other_CPU FROM sqlserver_monitoring.metrics_server WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time, server_name ORDER BY time

SELECT database_name, sum(size_mb) AS total_size_mb, sum(used_space_mb) AS used_mb FROM sqlserver_monitoring.metrics_database WHERE created_at = (SELECT max(created_at) FROM sqlserver_monitoring.metrics_database) GROUP BY database_name

SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, '1m') AS time, database_name, sum(io_stall_read_ms) AS Read_Stall_MS, sum(io_stall_write_ms) AS Write_Stall_MS FROM sqlserver_monitoring.metrics_disk_io WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time, database_name ORDER BY time
